I'll start by reading the guide and exploring the package.

Output was truncated; I'll read files individually.

I'll write the edits with a Python script, starting with settings and core.

I'll use edit_file and write_file instead. Settings first.

Shell calls are failing at this size, so I'll stick with edit_file.

Now run the patch, then update test_settings (the `ConfigureTest` class).

The refactor is finished. The tests pass (`python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`, 64 tests, OK). I compared the new package with a copy of the original through the command line and through library calls. None of the comparisons showed a difference.

- **Settings:** `Settings` is now frozen, and `settings.make(**values)` replaces `SETTINGS`, `configure`, `reset` and `current`. `make` only runs `parse_value` on each value, so `zone_overrides` and `discount_tiers` are still read when first needed.
- **`conf` parameter:** every function that needs a setting, directly or through a call, now takes `conf` as its first parameter after `self` or `cls`. The entry points have exactly the signatures in section 4 of the guide. Values that used to be read as attributes are now functions or methods taking `conf`:
  - `units.weight_factor` and `units.length_factor`
  - `Carrier.fuel_factor`, `Carrier.markup_pct` and `Carrier.minimum`
  - `pricing_date` in `timeutil`
- **Stale settings removed:** the old code read some settings at import time or kept results that ignored them. These now follow `conf`:
  - the unit factors
  - the dimensional divisor
  - the closed-days set (still derived from the pricing year)
  - the default tax rate
  - freight's minimum charge
  - the fuel factor cached on each carrier
  - the exchange-rate cache
  - the zone table cache
- **Caches:** the quote cache is now keyed by the settings value, so it is reused only for equal settings, and `cache.stats()` stays process-wide. The zone-table cache is keyed by the `zone_overrides` text.
- **Kept as the command line behaves:** text tables are always cut at 72 columns, and `--width` and `line_width` only affect label previews. The original read the width at import time, before the command line had applied any settings. I kept this because the guide says the command line is the reference.
- **Tests:** `tests/helpers.py` now gives each test its own `self.conf`, built with `make`, and a `self.use(**values)` helper. The old `ConfigureTest` became `MakeTest`, which also covers immutability, equality, hashing and the removal of the old API.

I ran the old and new command lines on 480 randomized runs. They varied the settings, the `--set`, environment, `--config` and global options, and the commands and output formats, using the sample batch files. Stdout, stderr and exit status all matched. I also ran 80 library calls with different settings in one process, and each matched the original command line. The new package has no old-API references left, every module imports on its own, and `make_request`, `quote_all` and the other entry points have the required signatures. Quotes are reused only for equal settings.

`/app/STATUS.json` is written with status `success`.

cd /app/quoter && for f in geo/*.py packing/*.py pricing/*.py output/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done

cd /tmp/orig && python -m quoter --width 30 carriers; python -m quoter --width 30 --set rounding=up quote --from DE-10115 --to FR-75001 --weight 2 --format label; python -m quoter --width 30 quote --from DE-10115 --to FR-75001 --weight 2 | head -3; cat tests/helpers.py tests/test_cli.py; ls samples; cat samples/customer-*.ini; head -5 samples/shipments-01.csv
cd /app/tests && cat test_zones.py test_output.py test_quotes.py test_batch.py test_settings.py; grep -rn 'line_width\|WIDTH' /app/quoter
cd /app/tests && python /tmp/fix_tests.py test_zones.py test_output.py test_quotes.py test_batch.py && grep -n 'self.conf\|self.use\|def make_request\|def berlin' test_*.py | head -80

cd /app/tests && sed -i 's/berlin_paris()/berlin_paris(self.conf)/g; s/^def berlin_paris(self.conf):/def berlin_paris(conf):/; s/    return make_request(self.conf, "DE-10115", "FR-75001", "2", "30x20x10")/    return make_request(conf, "DE-10115", "FR-75001", "2", "30x20x10")/' test_quotes.py && sed -n 8,16p test_quotes.py

python /tmp/helpers_patch.py && cd /app/tests && python - <<'EOF'
p='test_settings.py'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.index('class ConfigureTest')
j=s.index('if __name__')
new='''class MakeTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_make_converts(self):
        conf = settings.make(fuel_pct="9.5", carriers="ground")
        self.assertEqual(conf.fuel_pct, Decimal("9.5"))
        self.assertEqual(conf.carriers, ("ground",))

    def test_bad_value_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(SettingsError):
            settings.make(currency="USD", units="stone")
        with self.assertRaises(SettingsError):
            settings.make(colour="red")

    def test_fallback_values(self):
        conf = settings.make()
        self.assertEqual(conf, settings.Settings())
        self.assertEqual(conf.rate_card, "standard")
        self.assertEqual(conf.discount_tiers, "10:2,50:5,200:8")
        self.assertEqual(conf.carriers, settings.CARRIER_NAMES)
        self.assertTrue(conf.cache_enabled)
        self.assertEqual(conf.currency, "EUR")
        self.assertEqual(conf.json_indent, 2)

    def test_settings_are_immutable_and_comparable(self):
        conf = settings.make(currency="SEK")
        with self.assertRaises(FrozenInstanceError):
            conf.currency = "USD"
        self.assertEqual(conf, settings.make(currency="sek".upper()))
        self.assertEqual(hash(conf), hash(settings.make(currency="SEK")))
        self.assertNotEqual(conf, settings.make())
        self.assertEqual(settings.make().currency, "EUR")

    def test_old_process_wide_api_is_gone(self):
        for name in ("SETTINGS", "configure", "reset", "current"):
            self.assertFalse(hasattr(settings, name), name)

    def test_small_formats_are_read_when_needed(self):
        conf = settings.make(zone_overrides="CH=9", discount_tiers="10-2")
        self.assertEqual(conf.zone_overrides, "CH=9")


'''
s=s[:i]+new+s[j:]
s=s.replace('import unittest\nfrom decimal','import unittest\nfrom dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError\nfrom decimal').replace('from tests.helpers import SettingsCase, write_temp','from tests.helpers import write_temp')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cd /app && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -30

    print(f.__module__, f.__name__, inspect.signature(f))
c1=settings.make(fuel_pct='9'); c2=settings.make(fuel_pct='9.0'); c3=settings.make(fuel_pct='10')
